presentation.label: SPOOL
presentation.summary: A tempo-locked tape echo with flutter, wow, head wear, drive and a spring tail. Feed self-oscillates above about 90.
presentation.overview: A tempo-locked tape echo with flutter, wow, head wear, drive and a spring tail. Feed self-oscillates above about 90.
highlights: Play clipped notes and listen for repeated attacks, tape wear and wow as you raise feedback.
usage: Add Spool from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Play clipped notes and listen for repeated attacks, tape wear and wow as you raise feedback.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

controls.name: Tempo
controls.doc: BPM source for synced delay times. Descriptor is marked with the stock tempo flag pattern; true tap-tempo host writes still need hardware proof. Range 0–240.

controls.name: Div
controls.doc: Discrete musical division selector inside the DSP: 1/16, 1/8T, 1/8, dotted 1/8, 1/4, dotted 1/4. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Feed
controls.doc: Progressive repeats through 80; loop coefficient crosses unity near 92, reaching 1.4 at 100. Actual sustain depends on Wear, Drive and signal spectrum; record saturation bounds the loop. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Wear
controls.doc: Adds aged-tape filtering around the fixed Galaxy-derived head/tape FIR response. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Drive
controls.doc: TapeHack-style soft clipping into the record path. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Sprng
controls.doc: Experimental parallel mono spring-reverb return. Disabled by default while a closer Galaxy model is developed. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.

load.conditions: The effect descriptor declares this cost. Audio load on the pedal is unmeasured.
